title: What If Every GPS Satellite Switched Off Tomorrow?

scenes.text: What if every GPS satellite switched off tomorrow? Your map is the least of it.
GPS also carries the time. Banks, phone networks and utilities use its clock signal to stay in sync.
Within hours, systems that need tight timing would start to drift, and some would begin to fail.
A study commissioned by a US government agency put the loss at about one billion dollars a day.
Ports would slow down, because they use GPS to coordinate unloading ships.
Phone service would worsen within two days. The satellites don't just guide us. They keep time for the modern world.
